cottage_a.desc: Thatched cottage, two rooms; interior follows cottage_interior_empty.png (MN centre).

cottage_b.desc: Wide thatched cottage with stone base and wisteria (MN right).

cottage_c.desc: Narrow cottage with a steep thatch roof (MN back right).

cottage_d.desc: Farmer's cottage, braced timber frame, two rooms (MN back centre).

tavern.desc: The tavern: slate roof, stone base, awning, hanging sign, outdoor tables (MN left).

windmill_base.desc: Windmill: stone base, rough-wood tapered tower, loft with ladder, steep slate roof. Sails = windmill_sails.

well.desc: Village well: cobble ring + shaft with still water; well_roof prop on top.

plank_bridge.desc: Plank bridge spanning a 3-block stream (z 2..4) whose water surface is one block below the banks.

mausoleum.desc: Starting mausoleum: home, respawn point and storage. Tier-2 spectral stone.

graveyard_gate.desc: Graveyard entrance: low mossy wall, pillars, 2-wide gap.
